papers.summary: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. papers.title: SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
papers.summary: LLM-based agents are becoming increasingly capable at discovering, validating and patching vulnerabilities in real software, and vendors and researchers report that this is already changing how vulnerabilities are found and fixed. papers.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
papers.summary: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher.
